symptom: Every settings write added another blank line to the end of settings.toml, because toml-patch keeps the existing trailing newlines and the writer appended one more.
rule: Normalize a written settings file to exactly one final line ending in its own style, and test repeated writes of the same file rather than one write (principle 13).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/settings/__tests__/files.test.ts -t 'one newline|trailing blank lines'
